property_summary: For any caller and any block timestamp, calling C's payable fallback with exactly 10 ether always succeeds and updates pastBlockTime to a strictly larger value; the mutant that requires 5 ether will reject such 10-ether calls (or not update) for some inputs, violating this rule.
change_summary: Change the required msg.value from 10 ether to 5 ether, altering when the fallback accepts and updates state.
